skills.name: arwp-growth-loop
skills.description: Evidence-backed ongoing website growth loop for Search, recommendations, generative Search, AI citations and agent readability: research, hypothesize, implement, verify and measure.

skills.name: arwp-measurement-os
skills.description: Provider-native Search and AI measurement: readiness gates, generative Search exposure, Bing citations, AI crawler access, referrals, task outcomes, bounded page cohorts and evidence-safe longitudinal review.

skills.name: arwp-site-focus
skills.description: Define the site's primary problem territory, audience, explicit scope and anti-scope, problem-led information architecture, navigation, visual system and performance budget before content or discoverability expansion.

skills.name: arwp-search-maturity
skills.description: Reverse-engineer timestamped observable patterns from currently visible independent Search/AI reference pages, compare repeated cohort patterns with a target site and route grounded gaps into experiments without treating correlations as ranking factors.

skills.name: arwp-search-release
skills.description: Run a final hostname-root Search release interview across site identity, title sources, snippet hygiene, favicon delivery, canonical host, sitemap/robots, internal discovery, localization, GitHub Pages domain behavior, final build output and owner-observed Search appearance.

skills.name: arwp-adaptive-upgrade
skills.description: Compile a target site's current Growth evidence into source-backed upgrade recipes with exact change surfaces, verification contracts, measurement signals and knowledge-freshness gates.

skills.name: arwp-target-transformation
skills.description: Resolve adaptive upgrade recommendations to exact target-repository files and deliver deterministic, digest-gated production changes through local rollback-aware application or a new GitHub PR.

skills.name: arwp-braidgraph
skills.description: Trace source/rule evidence through recommendations and repository transformations, explain why a change exists, compute change blast radius and surface missing verification/outcome evidence through the canonical BraidGraph.

skills.name: arwp-prepare-site
skills.description: End-to-end repository preparation for ARWP, search quality, AI-search/citation readiness and agent interoperability.

skills.name: arwp-ai-search-content
skills.description: Improve articles, docs, comparisons and answer pages for human usefulness, retrieval and citation without AI filler or ranking promises.

skills.name: arwp-future-search
skills.description: Prepare healthy sites for emerging Search/AI/agent systems using governed future-ready semantics, semantic/evidence graphs, retrieval feedback and browser-agent operability beyond today's documented rich-result requirements.

skills.name: arwp-dataset-publication
skills.description: Audit and prepare genuine website corpora for versioned dataset releases, checksums, external archival publication and DOI-backed citation.

skills.name: arwp-agent-discovery
skills.description: Implement truthful agent discovery surfaces such as llms.txt, Agent Skills, ARD, MCP/A2A/OpenAPI and optional ARWP profiles.

skills.name: arwp-evidence-ci
skills.description: Add assertion contracts, scheduled audits, evidence receipts and regression-safe CI.

skills.name: arwp-discoverability
skills.description: Select concrete source-backed practices and validate editorial receipts within the Growth Loop; preserve native hypothesis/rule routing and unmeasured outcomes.

skills.name: arwp-portfolio-fleet
skills.description: Inspect and verify multiple local website repositories and public ARWP profiles from one workspace manifest without treating local checks as releases or outcomes.

composition.principle: Use the growth orchestrator and run Site Focus before broad content/discoverability expansion when the target site's problem territory, audience, scope or navigation is unclear. Use Measurement OS whenever Search/AI outcomes need provider-native baselines, page cohorts or stage-separated interpretation. Fix current eligibility and evidence-backed priorities first; invoke Search Maturity when a current intent needs a reviewed independent reference cohort; run Search Release before calling a public hostname ready so crawlability, site identity, title/snippet/favicon, canonical host, final build and owner-observed Search presentation remain separate evidence; compile accepted site-specific upgrades; use BraidGraph when provenance, impact or evidence debt must be traced; invoke Future Search only for grounded reversible semantic/retrieval experiments after foundations are healthy; then use Target Transformation only after exact files and grounded facts are resolved. Policy/editorial/owner/runtime decisions remain gated.
